{{Quote|I spent two summers with Papa on Null, after he and Mama split up. He taught me everything he could. And then he got killed.|[[Mirta Gev]]|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
'''Makin Marec''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], who came into contact with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ailyn Vel]] some [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. While Vel had initially been interested in Mandalorians only in an effort to better understand and hunt her estranged [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], Marec and Vel eventually entered into a relationship, [[Marriage/Legends|married]], and [[Reproduction/Legends|conceived]] a daughter together whom they named [[Mirta Gev|Mirta]]. Marec's relationship with Vel ultimately came to an end, though he continued to care for his daughter. Spending two [[Summer/Legends|summers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Null/Legends|Null]] with Mirta, Marec taught his daughter everything he could, including lessons on Mandalorian culture and how to speak the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] [[Language/Legends|language]] during their time together. He later [[Death/Legends|perished]] aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] during a [[Hull/Legends|hull]] breach, leaving Mirta to mourn the loss of her [[Parent/Legends|father]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Why'd Ailyn marry a Mando? Sintas must have warned her we're bad news.''"<br />"''She hung around ''Mando'ade'' to get a better idea of how to hunt you. Then she met Papa. It didn't last.''"<br />"''Romantic.''"<br />"''She cared about him.''"<br />"''And she let him make a Mando of you.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and Mirta Gev|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Makin Marec was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]].<ref name="Sacrifice" /> Some time after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|fall]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> Marec met the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ailyn Vel]]. In an effort to better understand and hunt her estranged [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], Vel had taken to spending [[Time/Legends|time]] among Mandalorians, eventually coming into contact with Marec. Marec and Vel began a relationship, and later [[Marriage/Legends|married]], even coming to [[Reproduction/Legends|conceive]] a daughter together whom they named [[Mirta Gev|Mirta]]. However, Vel and Marec's relationship was not to last, and the two later [[Divorce/Legends|divorced]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />

As she grew, Mirta came to regard Marec as "Papa," and spent two [[Summer/Legends|summers]] with her father on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Null/Legends|Null]],<ref name="Sacrifice" /> a world in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> There, Marec taught Mirta everything he could during their time together, instructing her on her Mandalorian heritage and the culture she had a connection to. Marec eventually [[Death/Legends|died]] aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], during an unfortunate [[Hull/Legends|hull]] breach, leaving Mirta to mourn the loss of one of her parents. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, Mirta recalled her father and his influence on her life during a number of brief conversations with her maternal grandfather, Boba Fett, following a reconciliation between the estranged family members. Fett credited Makin Marec with Mirta's decision to grow up Mandalorian.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Behind the scenes==
First given a nameless mention in the novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2006]], Makin Marec was later named and further detailed in Traviss' [[2007]] second entry into the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel series, entitled [[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice|''Sacrifice'']]. Marec was later indirectly mentioned in Traviss' subsequent novel, [[Legacy of the Force: Revelation|''Revelation'']], and given an informational entry in the [[2008]] reference book, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
